# FDN Spinner of Souls: "Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, you may reveal cards
# from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card. Put that card into your hand and
# the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order."
# The dies event: Basri's Lieutenant's CreatureDiesEvent over creatures you control, narrowed by
# "another" (FNot IS_SOURCE, Watcher of the Spheres) and "nontoken" (FNot IS_TOKEN, Gadrak). The
# effect is the dig the B16 templates compile for Vivien, Nature's Avenger's -1, byte for byte,
# inside the "you may": the second sentence moves "that card" and "the rest" of what was revealed,
# so it happens only if you reveal.
dies = CreatureDiesEvent(filter=FAnd(children=(
    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
    FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
    FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_TOKEN)),
)))
dig = Seq(steps=(
    A(Verb.REVEAL, {
        'controller': ControllerRef.YOU,
        'count': QConst(value=1),
        'until': FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
    }),
    Seq(steps=(
        A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
            'cards': Selector(
                count=QConst(value=1),
                mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                filter=FAnd(children=()),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                referent='result',
            ),
            'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        }),
        A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
            'arrange': 'RANDOM',
            'cards': Selector(
                count=QConst(value=1),
                mode=SelectorMode.REST,
                filter=FAnd(children=()),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.YOU,
                            position=ZonePosition.TOP),),
            ),
            'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.YOU,
                                position=ZonePosition.BOTTOM),
        }),
    )),
))
spinner = TriggeredAbility(event=dies, condition=None, effect=OptionalEffect(inner=dig))
abilities = [spinner, *compiled]
